practice_observation: The rest-state error EC-0 saw was fixed in the kernel (image foregrounds built from the native render, PR #33), not by shaping assets. EC-1a's own acceptance tests failed by design against the kernel until it implemented plan revisions #31 and #32, which worked as intended. EC-1a also caught a scope gap: PR #33's tests/test_image_foreground.py is missing from criterion 12's OWNED list, and EC-A is adding it. An independent Opus review (4 to 8 min, 115k to 230k tokens each) before every merge found real defects the implementer's tests missed, including both Highs, and re-running the same reviewer on each redesign caught the second High before merge. Costs: the image-foreground design took three attempts because each fix was judged only on the cases the previous review had named; mid-outcome direction changes forced rework; a 30 min runner queue and a flaky timing test cost two rebases and about two hours; EC-A's wall-clock fixture failed a correct kernel about one run in ten (fixed by PR #39); the Forgejo token cannot edit PR bodies.
